analyst_view.overall: Early view: Besiktas (4th) went into the break on a 3-0 win over Genclerbirligi, with Dusan Vlahovic on nine league goals and Leandro Trossard creating, but captain Orkun Kokcu is suspended after his latest yellow card. Konyaspor (15th) under Ilhan Palut have scored six goals in eleven games, have not won away and lost 1-0 at Samsunspor in their last match. Fabio Miretti, hurt against Crystal Palace, is targeting a return for this game.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.3 goals and I lean a touch lower. Konyaspor's games have produced just 20 goals in total, and without Kokcu, whose return was credited with lifting Besiktas's passing and tempo, Vincenzo Italiano's side lose their main playmaker; a Hurriyet columnist also flagged their away attacking as the area that still needs work.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.6 corners. Besiktas had about 70% of the ball in the first half against Genclerbirligi and should dominate possession again, which produces corners, while Konyaspor threatened from headers at Samsunspor; I stay near the number.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.8 cards. Konyaspor are a side under pressure (Enis Destan had a red card at Samsunspor reduced to a yellow after a VAR check) and Wilfred Ndidi was booked in the second minute last time out, so around five seems right.

shots.text: The numbers say 22.8 shots and I lean higher. Besiktas keep the ball and shoot often, with Trossard and Vlahovic combining for three goals last week, and Konyaspor's low block tends to invite many attempts from outside the box rather than clear chances.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.2 shots on target. More shots from distance against a packed defence do not mean many more on target, and Konyaspor rarely trouble keepers, so I keep it near eight.
